newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's January retail sales slumped 20.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's January retail sales slumped 20.5 pct.

text.p: Croatia's January retail sales slumped 20.5 percent from the previous month, but were 32.2 percent higher on an annual level.
January stocks shrank 5.4 percent month-on-month, but rose 12.4 percent from the previous year.
Some 500 leading retailers, accounting for over half of the country's total sales, forecast a modest 4.7-percent recovery in February.
January retail price inflation was 0.6 percent and 2.8 percent year-on-year.

The only branch to resist the downward trade was pharmaceuticals which grew 7.5 percent. Non-specialised shops recorded the biggest fall of 43.5 percent. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557-075
